title: Local Optimality Does Not Compose: Invariant Simplices and the Complexity of Shared Probabilistic Automata
summary: Probabilistic models are often constructed separately for different test suites and then expected to share a single latent dynamical system. We study bounded-state shared realization for probabilistic automata from finite partial trace specifications. A shared realization uses one normalized automaton with named initial distributions, a common family of row-stochastic letter-transition matrices, and one final output vector.
